item.title: FlickOff 1.2.0 (build 5)
item.description:
What's new in 1.2.0
- "When idle" replaces the "Don't dim when idle" checkbox. FlickOff can now turn the Touch Bar off after 1, 5 or 15 minutes without input, which skips the dim range that can flicker and spares the OLED. If you're updating, nothing changes until you choose. - Far less energy while idle: about 0.1% CPU instead of about 2.2%. - More reliable right after login, during fast user switching, and when macOS refuses a change. - Updates found in the background now show on the menu bar icon and in the menu. - Opening FlickOff while it runs shows its controls in a window, which helps if the menu bar icon is hidden.
